notes.title: Milk Tea Shop Simulator】Co-op Demo Out Now! Play Free 🍹
notes.content:
[p][/p][p align="start"][b]▶ Play Now[/b][/p][p align="start"]Search on Steam: [i]Milk Tea Shop Simulator – Rebirth: Becoming a Manager in Sweet City Iceburg[/i]
Store Page: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3683770/_/?utm_medium=link&utm_source=heybox"][/dynamiclink][/p][p align="start"]Price: Demo Free (Full version planned ¥38 with launch discount)[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]🎮 [b]About the Game[/b][/p][p align="start"][i]Milk Tea Shop Simulator[/i] is a cozy yet detail-rich life/management sim.
Start from a small shop—mix drinks, serve customers, manage supplies, decorate and expand, unlock recipes, and grow into a thriving chain.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631705/1ea0c9bc16d43c90eb6aa1e3dfd071175d610bc1.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The game blends free decoration with authentic drink-making: control tea base, milk/water, sugar, ice, fruit slices, pearls, and more. Meet NPCs with side stories (Grocery Boss, Fured, Sukole, Street Cat, etc.) as a lively little town slowly awakens.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631705/776cfc6c68260d2fa907e7888dd76e85f4efdacb.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Play solo or co-op with up to 4 players in the demo. Achievements, events, and hidden Easter eggs await. Supports both first- and third-person views.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631705/a48fcc9c2dc2560f3cb01146df48e77372ddd42a.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Buy recipes from Boss Wang’s store, or earn special ones through NPC interactions—some NPCs have a favorite drink![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631705/b548f2ee9712fb2e478564bea3d39324db628463.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]([i]Screenshots and feedback from playtesters here[/i])[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631705/139247d5723761ce47898d9fec4fbe49948d07b1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631705/3120974eda8d1c172f30c86ef4ffdd2003fd88fe.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631705/a4c8fa0d49329860ecf5af8f46ecf4e9c67ed57c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631705/233fc2d898ed3c9d3f5f8d834eaabcb427a38fd9.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]💬 [b]Feedback & Suggestions[/b][/p][p align="start"]Share your experience in the Steam discussions / official QQ group [b]722792074[/b] / or comment below:[/p][list][*][p]Device specs and issues (please include steps if reproducible)[/p][/*][*][p]Screenshots / short videos[/p][/*][*][p]Usability suggestions (UI, guidance, controls, balancing, etc.)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We will prioritize fixing [b]reproducible and flow-blocking issues[/b], and continue polishing through updates.[/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]🙏 [b]Special Thanks[/b][/p][p align="start"]Huge thanks to all playtesters! Your patience and feedback made this “first sip” taste better. Your play and reviews mean the world to our team.[/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]🔖 [b]Want to support us?[/b][/p][p align="start"]Add to Wishlist, leave a Steam review, or share this post with friends—it means a lot to an indie team![/p][p align="start"]Thanks again, Managers! The new counter is clean and ready—come try a cup! 🍯🧊🧋[/p][p align="start"][b]See you in Sweet City Iceburg![/b]
— Yours, IceBao[/p]

If you still experience any unpleasant issues while playing, please feel free to contact me.[/p][hr][/hr][h2] Additions[/h2][list][*][p]Added [b]cup holder prompt[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Recipes now show [b]unlocking methods[/b] in the recipe interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]footstep sounds[/b] for characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Added multiple new [b]advanced juicers[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]recipe crafting methods[/b], visible in the recipe interface.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Optimizations[/h2][list][*][p]Improved the [b]minus button hitbox[/b] in the recipe interface, making it easier to click.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized [b]sink collision[/b], so items dropped on top can still be selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased [b]font size of customer dialogues[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted [b]tutorial text issues[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Enlarged [b]cup holder text[/b], especially the number indicator.[/p][/*][*][p]Throwing away a ticket now makes the [b]ticket order pop up first[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where purchasing [b]purple paint[/b] displayed [b]Wallpaper 2[/b] instead.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with [b]small cups not showing water amount[/b] and having oversized collision.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed occasional issues where [b]cup UI didn’t display[/b] while holding a cup.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where drinks taken by customers remained floating after save/load.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]ingredients in cups[/b] appeared outside the cup after save/load.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where after save/load, [b]cup ticket attributes remained but the order disappeared[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where throwing a [b]watermelon[/b] into the slicer produced lemon slices.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]clients could not attack[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]UI didn’t disappear[/b] after gifting or throwing away a cup.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 2025/09/01 UpdateLog v0.08-0.09
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone, another day has passed and here are the latest fixes.
If you still experience any unpleasant issues while playing, please contact me.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h1]Optimizations[/h1][list][*][p]Optimized the collision model of the cutting board knife.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted item spoilage days, now increased to [b]2 days[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where after finishing all orders for the day and re-entering the game, no orders were left and money wasn’t deducted for undelivered drinks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, after emptying a full cup, players could not add ingredients again.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect default IDs on certain items that caused building failures.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where clients could not see the induction cooker progress bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where pet food could still be highlighted after purchase.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where pressing ESC on the settlement screen caused a freeze.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where clients saw all shop areas as unlocked when joining a game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where clients would freeze after purchasing a recipe.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Watermelon Iced Tea[/b] could not be made perfectly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where floor data could not be saved.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where induction cookers were unclickable after loading the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where clients couldn’t see cup tickets, interact with induction cooker items, or see pearls after joining.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where turning on the lights incorrectly deducted money.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where adding sugar before lemon prevented making Lemon Water.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where quickly clicking a cup during order completion allowed retrieving the served cup.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where clients completing the tutorial still saw it again on their second entry.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the exit button in the shopping cart and settlement screens was unclickable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where new customers at night could not be checked out. Now, all customers will no longer leave the queue after night falls.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 2025/08/31 UpdateLog v0.06-0.07
notes.content:
[h1]Update Note[/h1][p]Hello everyone, another day has passed, and here are the new issues I’ve fixed.
If you still experience any unpleasant gameplay feelings, please contact me.[/p][hr][/hr][h1]Improvements[/h1][list][*][p]Adjusted the number of customers, now linked to the popularity value based on player count.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the UI size of ice and sugar indicators in the top-left corner.[/p][/*][*][p]Added controller threshold settings in the options menu (visible when a controller is connected).[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the spawn point of lemon slices when cutting—no more exploding lemons.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the cashier sound attenuation settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a money deduction display in the settlement screen for orders not completed yesterday.[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed the large syrup container and large milk container.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where items picked up by a client were not visible to other members.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the displayed player name was incorrect when exiting the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where business hours would automatically start when beginning a new day.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where tutorial prompts remained in the scene even after skipping the tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where recipes purchased by clients in the shop were not unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where profit text animation in the settlement screen was too slow, causing the sound effect to loop endlessly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where object positions seen by clients were not synchronized with the host.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where expansions were not saved after rejoining the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where exterior walls were forced to change color.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, if a player disconnected during checkout, other players could not use the cashier desk.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the recipe screen on the client did not display currently listed recipes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where cup tickets could display the wrong information.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a mismatch in syrup capacity between host and clients.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where clients saw incorrect money amounts given by customers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the displayed spoilage days could become negative after cutting.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, under poor network conditions, drinks could be taken back immediately after being served.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the purchased green trash bin appeared as a purple trash bin.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 2025/08/30 Update Log v0.005
notes.content: [h1]Improvements[/h1][list][*][p]Updated player animations to make holding milk tea cups look more natural.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to cancel from the settlement screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a sound effect when receiving money after giving recyclables to Sucola.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased daily gameplay time limit.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a warning when trying to serve drinks with insufficient water.[/p][/*][*][p]Syrup can no longer be added after reaching the normal sugar level.[/p][/*][*][p]Doubled the speed of Fresh Orange Juice making.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the UI for syrup, ice, and cup size display on the cup.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some NPCs' clothing appeared missing on clients.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, when aiming at a cup, if another player changed the cup’s properties, the UI would update incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players couldn’t see other players’ ping in the settlement screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where hand animations did not reset after giving gifts to NPCs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players couldn’t place items in a cup if it was already full, and this wasn’t reflected to all players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the UI for a cup on the left side of the rack persisted even after placing a cup.[/p][/*][*][p]Possibly fixed an issue where placing cups into the sink at the same time could cause one to disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Possibly fixed an issue where placing lemons onto the cutting board simultaneously could cause a lemon to vanish.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where rotten items had no effect on customers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where rotten items would lose their rotten state when switching containers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Double Pearl Milk Tea could not be unlocked.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1] v0.04 Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Lemon Green Tea could not be crafted.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several issues related to spoilage logic.[/p][/*][*][p]Pearls no longer spoil.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where placing green tea in a pot after clearing it still showed as spoiled.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in multiplayer where clients could not discard trash from their hands.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, after viewing the sales analysis on the settlement screen, the next day could not be exited.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect values for large syrup amounts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a container that held one type of solution could not hold another type.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where feeding a kitten once would instantly unlock a new recipe.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a freeze that could occur when the second player joined in multiplayer.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the cashier desk could sometimes disappear.[/p][/*][/list]
